outcome: Maintenance of exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months postpartum
finding: While no significant association was found between early initiation of breastfeeding within 2 hours after birth and maintenance of exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months postpartum, low LATCH scores prior to hospital discharge were associated with lower rates of exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding occurred most often after vaginal and spontaneous births with spontaneous amniorrhexis.
